title: The Prophets The Lesson Of Divine Unity Through Miracles And Consensus

questions.question: Where did the traveler want to go next to learn more about Allah?
questions.answer: He wanted to enter the world of people.

questions.question: Who was leading humanity in that place?
questions.answer: The prophets were leading them.

questions.question: How did humanity welcome the traveler?
questions.answer: They invited him in.

questions.question: When he looked at the people of the past, whom did he see first?
questions.answer: He saw all the prophets.

questions.question: What were the prophets saying together?
questions.answer: They were declaring that Allah is the only God.

questions.question: What were the prophets doing besides speaking about Allah’s oneness?
questions.answer: They were remembering Allah.

questions.question: What did the prophets use to show that their message was true?
questions.answer: They were given many miracles.

questions.question: What were the prophets trying to teach people to do?
questions.answer: They were calling people to believe in Allah.

questions.question: What change were the prophets trying to help people make?
questions.answer: They were trying to raise people from a low level to a noble, angel-like level.

questions.question: What did the traveler do in that bright school?
questions.answer: He listened carefully to the lesson.

questions.question: What was in the hand of each great teacher as a sign of his mission?
questions.answer: Each had many miracles from Allah.

questions.question: What showed that many people trusted the prophets?
questions.answer: Big groups of people believed them and accepted their message.

questions.question: Why did the traveler think this truth was very firm?
questions.answer: Because many honest people agreed on it together.

questions.question: What did he understand about people who reject this truth?
questions.answer: They were making a very serious mistake and a great wrong.

questions.question: How did he see the people who believed the prophets?
questions.answer: He saw them as truthful and good.

questions.question: What became clearer to him after this?
questions.answer: The holiness and value of faith became clearer.

questions.question: Name one more thing in the passage that showed the prophets were truthful.
questions.answer: Their strong faith, their honest teaching, or their willingness to sacrifice.

questions.question: What happened to the traveler’s faith when he believed in all the prophets?
questions.answer: It gave his faith more strength.

questions.question: What was the traveler trying to do in his journey of learning?

questions.question: What made their call strong and bright?

questions.question: What were the prophets teaching people about belief?

questions.question: How did the traveler act in that school?
